description_short.value: Commercial bank in The Gambia, majority-owned by the Gambian social security fund, delisted from the Ghana Stock Exchange on 25 September 2026.
description_short.source: Written by us from GSE PR 391/2026 (delisting of Trust Bank PLC from the Ghana Stock Exchange) and the Trust Bank PLC 2025 Annual Report (GSE PR 231/2026)

description_full.value: Trust Bank PLC is one of the largest commercial banks in The Gambia by assets and branch network, serving retail and business customers from its head office in Banjul. It was founded in 1997, taking over the assets and liabilities of the failed Meridian Biao (Gambia) Bank, and its major shareholder is the Social Security and Housing Finance Corporation of The Gambia. It is no longer listed in Ghana: shareholders voted at the July 2024 annual general meeting to delist from the Ghana Stock Exchange so that the bank could focus on The Gambia. A tender offer by Solo Dabo Company Limited at GHS 1.20 a share, open from 17 August to 11 September 2026, drew 3,510,021 of the 7,328,773 shares on the Ghana register (47.89%). The shares were delisted on 25 September 2026, and the remaining Ghana holdings are being moved to the principal register in The Gambia. The bank reports in Gambian dalasi. Operating income roughly doubled from D678 million in 2021 to D1.40 billion in 2025, and profit rose from D143 million to D350 million. It has paid interim and final dividends every year, with D0.95 a share for 2025. In 2025 it doubled its share count to 400 million by transferring D200 million from statutory reserves. This is part of meeting a Central Bank of The Gambia rule that banks reach D500 million of capital by the end of 2026. It had 428 employees at the end of 2025.
description_full.source: Written by us from GSE PR 293/2024 (intention to delist), PR 351/2026 (tender offer), PR 391/2026 (delisting and offer results), the Trust Bank PLC 2025 Annual Report (GSE PR 231/2026: consolidated statements of comprehensive income and financial position, notes 9, 12, 13 and 26) and the 2021 Annual Report (GSE PR 093/2022: 2021 group operating income and profit)
